svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Credentials on a signed-in session host
svg.desc: A Microsoft Entra joined session host holds a Primary Refresh Token and a partial TGT from Microsoft Entra ID, access tokens for cloud apps, a Microsoft Entra Kerberos ticket for Azure Files, and a full TGT from a domain controller for on-premises resources.
svg.text: Plus a partial TGT for AD DS
One per app, from the PRT
Gets service tickets from the domain
